description: This source file implements the TpmKeyBlobMaker class, which handles creation, unwrapping, and configuration of TPM key blobs, including serialization, encryption, and signature verification for secure key management within the Android environment.

classes.name: TpmKeyBlobMaker
classes.description: A class responsible for creating, unwrapping, and managing TPM key blobs, including setting system version info and handling serialization and encryption.

methods.name: CreateKeyBlob
methods.description: Creates a TPM key blob with specified key description, origin, and key material, enforcing properties and serializing the key.

methods.name: UnvalidatedCreateKeyBlob
methods.description: Serializes and encrypts key material along with enforcement policies to produce a key blob.

methods.name: UnwrapKeyBlob
methods.description: Deserializes and verifies a key blob, extracting the key material if valid.

methods.name: SetSystemVersion
methods.description: Sets the OS version and patch level for key creation policies.

methods.name: SetVendorPatchlevel
methods.description: Sets the vendor patch level for key creation policies.

methods.name: SetBootPatchlevel
methods.description: Sets the boot patch level for key creation policies.
